concept: Practicing a physical skill gets you better at it, one small step at a time
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character practices a physical skill (catching a ball, riding a bike) and notices small improvements over time
exercise.reflection_prompt: What got easier for the character over time?
exercise.practice: Student names one physical skill they're working on and one small improvement they've noticed

assessment.success_marker: student names a real, specific improvement, not just 'I got better'
